videos.title: A Kiss at Midnight
videos.description: A professional matchmaker (Faith Ford) and a widower (Cameron Daddo) meet through an Internet dating service.

videos.title: Fixing Pete
videos.description: Sparks fly when Ashley (Brooke Burns) is asked to do a TV makeover for an obnoxious and sexist sports writer (Dylan Bruno).

videos.title: The Reading Room
videos.description: Street thugs jeopardize a widower's (James Earl Jones) mission to teach low-income people in his community how to read.

videos.title: Rescuing Madison
videos.description: Sparks fly between a singer (Alona Tal) and the handsome firefighter (Ethan Peck) who saved her life.

videos.title: Horton Foote's: Alone
videos.description: John Webb (Hume Cronyn) is recently widowed and living alone on the farm he and his brother used to share. He rarely sees his daughters, Jacqueline (Joanna Miles) and Grace Ann (Roxanne Hart), and his only company is Grey (James Earl Jones), the farm's longtime overseer. John's solitude is interrupted by his nephews, Carl (Frederic Forrest) and Gus Jr. (Chris Cooper), who have been approached about drilling for oil on the farm. Tensions rise as John clashes with his opportunistic family.

videos.title: The Wishing Well
videos.description: A reporter (Jordan Ladd) for a major network thinks a small town's wishing well is a joke until her wish is granted.

videos.title: Where There's a Will
videos.description: On the run from a loan shark, a con man (Frank Whaley) has a change of heart while staying with his grandmother (Marion Ross) in Texas.

videos.title: Bound & Babysitting
videos.description: Forced to baby-sit with her college nemesis (Travis Van Winkle), a young woman (Tammin Sursok) starts to see the man in a new light.

videos.title: How Not to Propose
videos.description: Things go awry when a man (Ryan Merriman) plans a romantic getaway to propose to his longtime girlfriend (Kayla Ewell).

videos.title: Expecting a Miracle
videos.description: Already facing difficult issues, a married couple (Jason Priestley, Teri Polo) find solace in a Mexican town when their car breaks down.

videos.title: Just Desserts
videos.description: With his family's Bronx bakery skating toward bankruptcy, baker Marco Poloni tries to prevent his Uncle Fab from selling the property. Marco teams up with the restaurant's pastry chef, Grace Carpenter, to enter a dessert competition with a $250,000 grand prize, hoping to split the earnings to save his bakery and give her money for her own restaurant. Initially at odds, the professional partners soon begin to develop feelings for each other.

videos.title: Uncorked
videos.description: A businesswoman (Julie Benz) meets a famous chef (Scott Elrod) and his family (JoBeth Williams, Elliott Gould) while visiting California's wine country.

videos.title: Diagnosis Delicious
videos.description: A young doctor (Maya Stojan) finds an effective cure for her stress when she attends a cooking class.

videos.title: Mary, Mother of Jesus
videos.description: This Biblical story of Jesus Christ is told through the eyes of the Virgin Mary (Pernilla August). Raised in Nazareth, Mary is betrothed to Joseph (David Threlfall) when the angel Gabriel appears to her, announcing that she is chosen to give birth to the messianic son of God, who will be conceived by the Holy Spirit. During a journey to Bethlehem for a Roman census, Mary gives birth to Jesus (Christian Bale), and later is witness to her son's miracles, as well as his persecution and crucifixion.

videos.description: Disheartened when Edward (Greg Evigan), her boyfriend of five years, fails to ask her to marry him, photographer Jordan Donovan (Teri Polo) takes her friend's advice and flies to Wyoming for a blind date with rancher Tyler Ross (Andrew McCarthy). The two overcome their initial dislike of each other and fall in love, but Tyler is haunted by the death of his wife, while Jordan is still attached to Edward. Worried they may not be able to maintain a relationship, Jordan returns to New York City.
